text:
Under two minutes a triangle.

Up it goes, flat, under the crossing. The hook tops out 6.1 metres up, 20 feet. A small twelve volt winch brings in about 4 metres a minute at this load, so a triangle takes 1.5 minutes to raise, and all forty about an hour of winding. Flat matters: a triangle that tips on the way up catches the line, the X, and anyone underneath.
